summary: Century Casinos, Inc. disclosed a September 24, 2026 Share Purchase Agreement under which subsidiary Century Resorts Management GmbH will sell the racing and gaming operations of Century Mile (Edmonton) and Century Downs (Calgary) to Racing Entertainment Centre Holdings Inc., parented by Highfield Investment Group Inc., for about $16.4 million, subject to working-capital adjustment. The Company owns 100% of Century Mile and 75% of Century Downs. VICI-owned real estate stays under an amended triple-net master lease; Highfield becomes tenant, cutting annual rent roughly $7.5 million. Proceeds reduce debt. Closing awaits gaming approvals; either party may terminate if closing lags 365 days. Watch regulatory timing and working-capital true-up.
